BEN.note: Nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.
AI is stated only inside customs, a sector system.

facts.fact: Webb Fontaine says Benin's customs system Webb Customs, equipped with AI, now bases risk management on intelligent profiling of importers and goods and automatically detects fraud patterns.

BEN.note: No AI model, dataset or AI computing built or hosted in the country is stated.

facts.fact: Webb Fontaine says Webb Customs has replaced Sydonia World in Benin, with fully automated customs procedures, and at the Hilla-Condji border all formalities are completed online.

Webb Fontaine says a reform in January 2018 created the Foreign Trade Single Window (GUCE), merging the Port Single Window, the Foreign Trade Operations Single Window and Sydonia World into one interface.
